description: Act WITHOUT checking the result — if the action is supposed to cause something, use reticle_act_and_wait { until } instead and get the verdict in the same call. e.g. {"ref":"e42","action":"fill","args":{"value":"hello"}}

args.description: Action-specific arguments: { value } for fill/select, { text } for type/press (the key NAME, e.g. Escape or Tab), { modifiers: ["Meta","Shift"] } for a press s…

burst.description: ms gap between dispatches, to provoke an ordering race (try 50).

onDeviation.description: What to do when a step's `expect` does not hold.

ref.description: Element ref (e.g. 'e42') from reticle_look { action: "page" }/reticle_look { action: "find" } — stable until the element leaves the DOM, so no re-snapshot between actions.

refuseWhenThrottled.description: Throw instead of silently sending synthetic events when the tab is throttled/backgrounded.

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

steps.description: Ordered list of { ref | target, action, args?, expect? } objects.

target.description: Find the element and act on it in ONE call, instead of a reticle_look { action: "find" } round trip first: { testid } | { text } | { role, name } | { label }.

name: reticle_act
